password.title: Password
password.description: Changing your password signs out your other sessions.
password.saved: Password updated. Your other sessions have been signed out.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.enabled: Your account is protected with an authenticator.
mfa.disabled: Add an authenticator to protect your account with a second sign-in step.
mfa.unsaved: Save your recovery codes before leaving this page. If you no longer have them, generate a replacement set.
mfa.replaceDescription: Your current recovery codes will stop working. Save the new set to keep a way back into your account.
mfa.disableDescription: Your authenticator and recovery codes will stop working. Workspaces that require two-factor authentication will block changes until you enable it again.
mfa.saved: Your recovery codes are saved. Keep them somewhere private.
